description: This file defines the MultiPointStrategy class for managing cache points in a message processing system, including logic for determining optimal cache placements based on token counts and message roles.

classes.name: MultiPointStrategy
classes.description: A class extending CacheStrategy that manages cache point placement for message caching based on token thresholds.

methods.name: determineOptimalCachePoints
methods.description: Calculates and returns the optimal cache point placements based on current configuration and message tokens.

methods.name: determineMessageCachePoints
methods.description: Determines cache point placements within message sequences, handling new and growing conversations.

methods.name: findOptimalPlacementForRange
methods.description: Finds the best cache point placement within a message range, typically the last user message.

methods.name: formatWithoutCachePoints
methods.description: Formats and returns cache result without any cache points.
